name: Youthful Disciple Holding Incense Box and Bag (probably Ananda)
summary: Standing figure of a youthful arhat (Ananda) facing proper left, holding an incense box and a small bag with loop handles.  Low sandstone relief from Cave 3 (north wall) at Tianlongshan, Shanxi province.
